ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Process Suspension via WERFaultSecure through EDR-Freeze
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects attempts to freeze a process likely an EDR or an antimalware service process through EDR-Freeze that abuses the WerFaultSecure.exe process to suspend security software.

sequences.query: (process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\WerFaultSecure\.exe" AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/h\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/pid\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/tid\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/encfile\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/cancel\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/type\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ 268310.*")))
